skill.name: Markdown Rendering
skill.purpose: Sole Markdown writer (Claude Sonnet 4.5). Render schema-complete human-readable Markdown from backlog JSON. Do not author JSON.
rules: JSON is authoritative.
Preserve Epic -> Feature -> Story hierarchy.
Display FAC/AAC at Feature level.
Display full technical LLD sections at Story level.
Display SAC at Story level.
Preserve exact Story area names.
Do not add content not present in JSON.
Write src/artifacts/projections/backlog/ folder tree mirroring canonical (Epic/Feature/FAC/AAC/ST/SAC).
Write folder-tree Markdown under src/artifacts/projections/backlog/ mirroring canonical 1:1 (not a single backlog.md only).
NEVER remove, drop, merge, or omit any Epic folder under projections/backlog/Epic/.
Projection Epic count MUST equal canonical Epic count.
On Governance FAIL leave existing Epic markdown untouched.

JSON agents write schema-complete JSON under src/artifacts/canonical/backlog/ only. Markdown Renderer (Claude Sonnet 4.5) writes matching .md twins under src/artifacts/projections/backlog/. Do not dual-write Markdown from JSON agents.
JSON path root: src/artifacts/canonical/backlog/. Markdown path root: src/artifacts/projections/backlog/.
All skill schema required_fields must be present and non-empty before status=complete; otherwise status=incomplete and retry.
Never write under src/canonical/ or use flat Feature/FAC/AAC siblings of Epic.
Markdown Renderer creates/reconciles Markdown as soon as canonical JSON exists; strictly mirror required schema fields.
You ALWAYS write .md twins. json_only_no_markdown_writes is forbidden. Do not skip because validation.json is missing or not PASS.
The JSON-agent do-not-write-Markdown rule does not apply to Markdown Renderer.
Reconcile missing .md files under src/artifacts/projections/backlog/ to match canonical nested tree 1:1.
Write src/artifacts/projections/backlog/ folder tree (not only backlog.md).
Never paste a full JSON object or JSON code fence of the source artifact into Markdown.
When mentioning Epic/Feature/FAC/AAC/Story/SAC, write title/name plus id, never the id alone.

schema_completeness_gate.rule: STRICT schema compliance — All output.required_fields must be present and non-empty before status=complete; never rename/drop/stub required fields

feature_selection.when_empty: LLM decides how many Features each Epic needs from evidence.
feature_selection.when_provided: Tokens epic-N-feature-M. N=1-based Epic order; M=exact Feature count.

story_layer_selection.when_provided: Tokens epic-N-feature-M-story-<layers>. Only those layers get Stories.

skill.human_readable_refs: Never refer to Epic/Feature/FAC/AAC/Story/SAC by ID alone; always include the human title/name with the id.
skill.markdown_no_json_dump: Never paste full JSON into Markdown. JSON already exists in canonical files.
